objective: Separate appearance mode switching from theme layout settings and provide an accessible radial menu with page-wide color diffusion.

requirements.statement: The current appearance mode is represented by Sun, Moon, or Monitor and persists through the existing theme store.
The mode choices expand radially from the trigger and can be closed predictably.
Changing mode creates a page-wide diffusion from the trigger center and honors reduced motion.
The settings drawer does not duplicate appearance mode controls.
acceptance: drawer keeps palette layout tabs density

selected_approach.name: shared ThemeModeFan component
selected_approach.reason: one reusable interaction keeps both layout headers visually and behaviorally consistent

approval.evidence: User confirmed the proposed interaction on 2026-08-10.
